supporting_observations.claim: The only PowerShell process creation shown on WS-JFROST-01 in the provided records is at 13:42:53 UTC, running as ali.hassan with the exact approved command to execute \\FILE-MAP-01\IT\Patch-Workstations.ps1. The matching process-creation records identify the same logon ID.

A network logon for ali.hassan from WS-AHASSAN-01 to WS-JFROST-01 occurred shortly before that PowerShell process and used the same logon ID as the process. This is consistent with the stated remote-patching practice, though it does not establish who initiated the session.
The PowerShell process launched wusa.exe to install a Windows 11 KB update, which is consistent with workstation patching.

Explorer recorded UserAssist registry updates by julia.frost for a ROT13-encoded path that decodes to powershell.exe, at 13:32:27 and 14:12:59 UTC. These records do not show the associated process command line or establish that a Julia-launched PowerShell window appeared around 13:40.
The reported time is approximate, and the observed authorized patch-script PowerShell process began at 13:42:53 UTC; the available records do not directly identify a PowerShell process at 13:40.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied process records do not establish whether the PowerShell window reported by Julia was the 13:42:53 patch-script process or another execution.
The records show the patch script path and its child installer, but not the script contents, integrity, or complete execution output.
The UserAssist entries record a PowerShell path but do not provide the launched process's command line or explain what it did.
claims_not_established: Whether Julia's reported window corresponds to the PowerShell process running as ali.hassan at 13:42:53 UTC.
Whether Julia launched PowerShell herself around 13:40, or what command or script any such execution used.
Whether the patch session was authorized and initiated by ali.hassan, beyond its consistency with the stated practice and account/logon records.
additional_evidence_needed: PowerShell operational and script-block logs, including event IDs 4103 and 4104, for WS-JFROST-01 around 13:20–14:20 UTC.
Endpoint process telemetry or EDR records that can identify any PowerShell process not represented in the supplied process-creation records.
